explanations.1: This sets the color of matching search results to red in the output.
explanations.2: This makes the matching text appear bold, layering the style on top of the red color from line 1.
explanations.4: This tells the search tool to follow symbolic links (shortcuts) when scanning directories.
explanations.5: The exclamation mark means 'ignore this pattern', so .cache folders won't be searched.
explanations.13: This includes hidden files and folders (those starting with a dot) in the search, which are normally skipped.
explanations.14: This skips files larger than 10 megabytes to keep the search fast and avoid huge files.
